flags.title: Two ESL Challenger League rows rest on a single market (HLTV pages found on re-check)
flags.detail: HLTV per-match pages were captured on re-check (2399204 ex-Keyd Stars vs Galorys, SA Cup 3 playoffs, bo3; 2399232 Zomblers vs Overtake Sector, NA Cup 3 playoffs, bo3) and are cited on both rows, so the earlier 'no HLTV page' flag is closed. What remains: neither fixture had a two-sided bc.game/EGamersWorld line at capture time (EGamersWorld showed no such fixture), so both lines rest on the Polymarket market alone.
flags.action: Reviewer: add a book line if one appears before these matches lock.

flags.title: Hotspawn crowd vs market disagreement (largest gaps)
flags.detail: ex-Keyd Stars vs Galorys: crowd 86% ex-Keyd Stars vs Polymarket 33c/68c (market favours Galorys). HOTU vs Fnatic: crowd 91% Fnatic vs bc.game 1.93/1.83 (near coin-flip). MIBR vs BC.Game: crowd 70% BC.Game vs bc.game 1.64/2.20 (market favours MIBR). Gothic vs Lavked: crowd 90% Lavked and bc.game 1.881/1.782 (favours Lavked) vs Polymarket 53c/47c (favours Gothic).
flags.action: These are genuine source disagreements, not errors in this dataset. Both numbers are shown with links.

flags.title: Team-name aliases between sources (WROTBERRY / WBT)
flags.detail: Hotspawn 'WROTBERRY' occupies exactly the slots HLTV and Polymarket label 'WBT'. Supporting evidence captured 2026-10-13: EGamersWorld's team page for that roster resolves to the URL slug /counterstrike/team/wrotberry-0I2cpR8LZA while displaying the name 'WBT'. 'RoundsGG' = HLTV 'ROUNDS' = EGW 'Rounds' (EGW logo file roundsgg-logo.webp; Polymarket market slugs use 'rgg'). 'EAC' = EGW 'EA Copenhagen' = Polymarket 'Esport Academy Copenhagen'.
flags.action: Reviewer: confirm that WBT and WROTBERRY are the same organisation before acting on those rows.

flags.title: FORZE Reload opponent mismatch in both external markets
flags.detail: Hotspawn and HLTV both list FORZE Reload vs LFO 10 at 2026-10-14 17:00 UTC. Polymarket lists the same slot as 'FORZE Reload vs Sokerorg' (FORZE 95c / opponent 12c), and the EGamersWorld schedule row renders the opponent as a blank team link with placeholder 1.8/1.8 odds. No market therefore pairs FORZE Reload with LFO 10, and the row is left blank rather than guessing which opponent the prices refer to.
flags.action: Reviewer: confirm whether LFO 10 and Sokerorg are the same roster, then the listed prices can be attached.

flags.title: Fixture team order differs between sources (price mapping corrected)
flags.detail: Hotspawn: RoundsGG vs Voca. HLTV match page and the Polymarket market: Voca first (HLTV slug 'voca-vs-rounds'). Prices are mapped by team name - RoundsGG 47c (underdog) / Voca 91c, and bc.game 6.3 / 1.08. An earlier build of this dataset double-flipped that market; the published values are corrected and were re-checked against the market page on 2026-10-13.
flags.action: None - kept as a record of the correction.

flags.title: Placeholder-looking 1.8/1.8 odds on several EGamersWorld rows
flags.detail: EGW shows identical 1.8/1.8 decimals for Black Phoenix vs 6666, ex-RUSTEC vs mellren and the unnamed FORZE Reload opponent, a pattern consistent with an unset line; rows with real lines show unequal values (e.g. Gothic 1.881 / Lavked 1.782, HAVU 1.2 / Rounds 4.0). Every 1.8/1.8 pair was excluded from the derivations.
flags.action: Reviewer: spot-check those EGW rows before trusting any future re-pull.

flags.title: Odds move between components and between captures
flags.detail: 9z vs Aurora: 3.3/1.26 (EGW match page), 3.6/1.27 (EGW event odds module) and 3.8/1.22 (EGW schedule list) on 2026-10-13. Falcons vs NiP: 1.23/3.95 and 1.22/3.8. Later re-checks the same evening showed 3.6/1.27 again. Every price in this dataset is a point-in-time snapshot.
flags.action: Reviewer: treat all prices as snapshots; re-pull before acting.

flags.title: Polymarket market times for Elisa BreakOut run 4 hours earlier than every other source
flags.detail: On 2026-10-13 the Elisa BreakOut market pages showed e.g. 'Voca vs Phantom Oct 16, 4:00 AM' and 'Phantom vs HAVU Oct 16, 2:00 PM', four hours earlier than the lobby payload epoch, HLTV and EGamersWorld for the same fixtures (08:00 / 18:00 UTC). Polymarket's ESL Challenger League market times matched the UTC schedule exactly, so the deviation is Polymarket-side and tournament-specific. No price was adjusted for it; the kickoff column uses the lobby-payload/HLTV times.
flags.action: Reviewer: treat Polymarket start times for this tournament as display noise.

flags.title: Prediction-market spreads are wide on low-liquidity fixtures
flags.detail: Polymarket detail prices on several Elisa BreakOut fixtures sum to 125-139 cents, indicating a wide bid/ask and near-zero volume. Those prices were normalised before use and the rows are marked Low/Medium quality where the two markets disagree.
flags.action: Reviewer: prefer the bc.game line where both exist.

flags.title: Hotspawn pick percentages tick continuously
flags.detail: Captured crowd percentages moved between two snapshots 20 minutes apart (e.g. ex-Keyd Stars 83% -> 86%, Falcons 94% -> 89%). All displayed percentages are one snapshot and are never used in any probability.

flags.title: Coverage boundary: 86 entries in the lobby payload, 26 open for picks
flags.detail: The lobby's SSR payload holds 86 CS2 fixture entries: 26 with start times after the snapshot (this dataset, all priced) and 60 with start times in the past - 59 dated 2026-06-26 to 2026-06-28, one 2026-07-10 and two earlier on 2026-10-13 - all still reported as 'scheduled' by the source. Those stale entries cannot be picked and are not priced here. The independent row-level audit of that payload is committed in this repository (audits/1d4de836/lobby-snapshot-audit.json).
flags.action: Reviewer: say if the stale entries should also be listed (their odds columns would be blank).

flags.title: HLTV betting-analytics pages do not expose numeric odds to this pipeline
flags.detail: HLTV's '/betting/analytics/<id>/<slug>' pages render analytics (form, head-to-head, handicap distributions, map stats) but the numeric decimal odds table did not render as machine-readable text (values such as '1.23eOddset' appear to be parsing artefacts). HLTV figures were therefore used for verification only, not as a price source.

flags.title: League of Legends pick'em tab not covered
flags.detail: play.hotspawn.com/lol-pickems exists (per sitemap). This dataset covers the CS2 pick'em lobby only.
flags.action: Reviewer: say if LoL should be added.

flags.title: Pool-size counters differ between renders
flags.detail: The lobby filter showed 'All tiers (86), B (27), C (55), S (4)' in one render and 'All tiers (85), B (26), C (55), S (4)' minutes later (matches starting drop out of the pool).
